problem_summary: 6 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Konankunte between February 2019 and July 2022, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 100% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened). 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after initially being resolved.

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 93 pothole complaints.
35 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹39.9 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): Road work contracts exist in this ward, yet 100% of complaints remain unresolved. This may indicate that repairs were incomplete, inadequate, or that the work was performed in different road segments. Independent verification required.
HYPOTHESIS (unverified): 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after being marked resolved. This may indicate short-term or superficial repairs that did not address the underlying problem.
agency_attribution_note: 6 of 6 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.53). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=1.00, complaint_volume=0.20.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Konankunte' matched to datameet243=221 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.83).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Konankunte for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 35 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Investigate the 1 re-opened complaint(s) to determine whether patchwork repairs were applied and failed.
